# Dashboard

## Data preparation

```{r}
library("dashboardr")
library(forcats)
library(tidyverse)
library(highcharter)

GenAIuse_groups = factor(c("Never", "Once a week", "2-4 times per week ", "(Almost) every day", "Several times a day"))

data = read_csv('data_modified_04022026.csv')

data = data %>%
  mutate(GenAI_use = fct_relevel(GenAI_use, 
                                 "Never", "Once a week", "2-4 times per week", 
                                 "(Almost) every day","Several times a day"),
    Q8_trust_publisher = fct_relevel(Q8_trust_publisher, 
                                     "Not important at all", "Of little importance", 
                                     "Of average importance", "Very important"),
    Q8_realism = fct_relevel(Q8_realism, 
                             "Not important at all", "Of little importance", 
                             "Of average importance", "Very important"),
    Q8_misinfo_risk = fct_relevel(Q8_misinfo_risk, 
                                  "Not important at all", "Of little importance", 
                                  "Of average importance", "Very important"),
    Q8_human_in_the_loop = fct_relevel(Q8_human_in_the_loop, 
                                       "Not important at all", "Of little importance", 
                                       "Of average importance", "Very important"),
    Q6_read = fct_relevel(Q6_read, 
                                 "Very unwilling", "Somewhat unwilling", "Neutral", 
                                 "Somewhat willing","Very willing"),
    Q6_share = fct_relevel(Q6_share, 
                                 "Very unwilling", "Somewhat unwilling", "Neutral", 
                                 "Somewhat willing","Very willing"),
    Q6_trust = fct_relevel(Q6_trust, 
                                 "Very unwilling", "Somewhat unwilling", "Neutral", 
                                 "Somewhat willing","Very willing"),
    Q6_talk = fct_relevel(Q6_talk, 
                                 "Very unwilling", "Somewhat unwilling", "Neutral", 
                                 "Somewhat willing","Very willing"),
    Q6_ignore = fct_relevel(Q6_ignore, 
                                 "Very unwilling", "Somewhat unwilling", "Neutral", 
                                 "Somewhat willing","Very willing"),
    Q10_free_companies =fct_relevel(Q10_free_companies, 
                                 "Strongly disagree", "Disagree", 
                                 "Neither agree, nor disagree", 
                                 "Agree","Strongly agree"),
    Q10_government_decides = fct_relevel(Q10_government_decides, 
                                 "Strongly disagree", "Disagree", 
                                 "Neither agree, nor disagree", 
                                 "Agree","Strongly agree"),
    Q10_right_to_complain = fct_relevel(Q10_right_to_complain, 
                                 "Strongly disagree", "Disagree", 
                                 "Neither agree, nor disagree", 
                                 "Agree","Strongly agree"),
    Q10_involve_civil_society = fct_relevel(Q10_involve_civil_society, 
                                 "Strongly disagree", "Disagree", 
                                 "Neither agree, nor disagree", 
                                 "Agree","Strongly agree"),
    Q10_only_regulate_high_risk = fct_relevel(Q10_only_regulate_high_risk, 
                                 "Strongly disagree", "Disagree", 
                                 "Neither agree, nor disagree", 
                                 "Agree","Strongly agree"),
    Q10_developers_are_responsible = fct_relevel(Q10_developers_are_responsible,
                                 "Strongly disagree", "Disagree",
                                 "Neither agree, nor disagree",
                                 "Agree","Strongly agree"),
    Q9_engaging = fct_relevel(Q9_engaging,
                              "Strongly disagree", "Disagree",
                              "Neither agree, nor disagree",
                              "Agree", "Strongly agree"),
    Q9_improving_user_experience = fct_relevel(Q9_improving_user_experience,
                              "Strongly disagree", "Disagree",
                              "Neither agree, nor disagree",
                              "Agree", "Strongly agree"),
    Q9_missing_important_news = fct_relevel(Q9_missing_important_news,
                              "Strongly disagree", "Disagree",
                              "Neither agree, nor disagree",
                              "Agree", "Strongly agree"),
    Q9_risking_privacy = fct_relevel(Q9_risking_privacy,
                              "Strongly disagree", "Disagree",
                              "Neither agree, nor disagree",
                              "Agree", "Strongly agree"),
    Q9_spreading_misinfo = fct_relevel(Q9_spreading_misinfo,

                              "Strongly disagree", "Disagree",

data = data %>%
  mutate(
    age_cat = fct_relevel(
      recode(nagecat,
        "18 t/m 24" = "18-24",
        "25 t/m 34" = "25-34",
        "35 t/m 44" = "35-44",
        "45 t/m 54" = "45-54",
        "55 t/m 70" = "55-70"
      ),
      "18-24", "25-34", "35-44", "45-54", "55-70"
    ),
    education = fct_relevel(education, "Low", "Middle", "High")
  )

# Note shown on every breakdown by education
edu_note = "<i><b>Education levels:</b> low (hasn't finished highschool), middle (finished highschool but not university), high (finished university)</i>"

# Helper: build a stacked-bar subgroup breakdown with nested
# demographic-level and country tabs (All Countries first, then each country)
add_stack_subgroups = function(content, x_vars, x_labels, stack_order, palette, tab_prefix) {
  demo = list(
    list(var = "age_cat",   label = "By Age Group", levels = c("18-24", "25-34", "35-44", "45-54", "55-70")),
    list(var = "gender",    label = "By Gender",    levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    list(var = "education", label = "By Education", levels = c("Low", "Middle", "High"))
  )
  countries = c("Netherlands", "Denmark", "USA", "Brazil", "South Africa", "Japan")
  for (d in demo) {
    sub = if (d$var == "education") edu_note else ""
    for (lev in d$levels) {
      tg = paste0(tab_prefix, "/", d$label, "/", lev)
      content = content %>%
        add_viz(x_vars = x_vars, x_var_labels = x_labels, stack_order = stack_order,
                color_palette = palette, stacked_type = "percent",
                filter = as.formula(sprintf('~ %s == "%s"', d$var, lev)),
                x_label = "", y_label = "Percent (%)", tooltip_suffix = "%", title = "",
                subtitle = sub,
                title_tabset = "All Countries", tabgroup = tg)
      for (co in countries) {
        content = content %>%
          add_viz(x_vars = x_vars, x_var_labels = x_labels, stack_order = stack_order,
                  color_palette = palette, stacked_type = "percent",
                  filter = as.formula(sprintf('~ %s == "%s" & country == "%s"', d$var, lev, co)),
                  x_label = "", y_label = "Percent (%)", tooltip_suffix = "%", title = "",
                  subtitle = sub,
                  title_tabset = co, tabgroup = tg)
      }
    }
  }
  content
}

# Trust preprocessing
data = data %>%
  mutate(trust_news = case_when(
    kari_trust_news_media < 4 ~ "low",
    kari_trust_news_media > 7 ~ "high",
    TRUE ~ 'medium'
  ),
  trust_news = fct_relevel(trust_news, 'low', 'medium', 'high'),
  trust_chatGPT = case_when(
    kari_trust_chatGPT < 4 ~ "low",
    kari_trust_chatGPT > 7 ~ "high",
    TRUE ~ 'medium'
  ),
  trust_chatGPT = fct_relevel(trust_chatGPT, 'low', 'medium', 'high'),
  trust_social_media = case_when(
    kari_trust_social_media < 4 ~ "low",
    kari_trust_social_media > 7 ~ "high",
    TRUE ~ 'medium'
  ),
  trust_social_media = fct_relevel(trust_social_media, 'low', 'medium', 'high')
  )

# Q5 feeling thermometers (0 = negative, 100 = positive): reshape the five
# items into long format so they can be compared as side-by-side box plots.
q5_long = data %>%
  select(
    country, age_cat, gender, education,
    `Check if the content is based on facts or reality`                                          = Q5_fact_check,
    `Identify the origins of the content, such as the author or the sources of information`      = Q5_identify_contents_origin,
    `Understand the writers' character, beliefs or personality`                                  = Q5_understanding_the_writer,
    `Understand which journalistic values, such as impartiality or accuracy, the content represents` = Q5_understanding_journalistic_values,
    `The ability to judge whether a human being was involved in the writing of the content`      = Q5_judging_human_involvement
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(country, age_cat, gender, education), names_to = "item", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(item = fct_inorder(item))

authenticity_rankings <- data %>%
  select(country, starts_with("Q4_")) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("Q4_") & ends_with("numeric"), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Q4_") & ends_with("numeric"),
                ~ rank(-c_across(starts_with("Q4_") & ends_with("numeric")))[which(c_across(starts_with("Q4_") & ends_with("numeric")) == .x)],
                .names = "{.col}_rank")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-ends_with("numeric"))

authenticity_bump = authenticity_rankings %>%
  pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "item", values_to = "rank") %>%
  mutate(
    item = recode(item,
                  "Q4_based_on_fact_numeric_rank"       = "Journalistic content that is based on facts or reality",
                  "Q4_identify_origin_numeric_rank"     = "Journalistic content where it is easy to identify the author and sources of information",
                  "Q4_expresses_character_numeric_rank" = "Journalistic content that expresses the writer's character, beliefs or personality",
                  "Q4_journ_values_numeric_rank"        = "Journalistic content that follows established journalistic values, such as honesty, impartiality and/or accuracy",
                  "Q4_written_by_a_human_numeric_rank"  = "Journalistic content that is written by a human being"
    ),
    rank = rank  # rank 1 = least important
  )
```

```{r}
home = create_page("Home", is_landing_page = TRUE) %>%
  add_text(
    "Welcome to the Global AI in Journalism Monitor!", 
    "The AI, Media and Democracy Lab surveyed 6,961 people across six geographically and culturally diverse countries: Brazil, Denmark, Japan, the Netherlands, South Africa, and the United States to get insights into what people across the globe think about the impact of AI on journalism.",
    "We were interested in three questions: (1) How do people understand authenticity in times of AI, (2) How does journalistic AI use affect their general attitudes and possible engagement with content, as well as what journalistic principles should guide the use of AI and (3) what their preferences are regarding AI regulation.",
    "To explore differences and similarities across countries and different subgroups, click on the tabs above. They will guide you to the core concepts we measured.",
```

### Authenticity Rankings

```{r}
countries_order = c("Netherlands", "Denmark", "USA", "Brazil", "South Africa", "Japan")

bump_viz = viz_timeline(
  data       = authenticity_bump,
  time_var   = "country",
  y_var      = "rank",
  group_var  = "item",
  agg        = "none",
  chart_type = "line",
  title      = "",
  y_label    = "Rank",
  y_min      = 1,
  y_max      = 5,
) %>%
  hc_yAxis(reversed = TRUE, min = 1, max = 5)

authenticity_ranking_viz = create_content(data = authenticity_bump,
                                          type = "timeline") %>%   add_hc(bump_viz)

authenticity_ranking_viz %>% preview
```

## AI Journalism attitudes

### AI news engagement intentions

```{r}
q6_vars <- c("Q6_read", "Q6_share", "Q6_trust", 
             "Q6_talk", "Q6_ignore")

q6_labels = c(Q6_read = "Read", Q6_share = "Share", Q6_trust = "Trust",
              Q6_talk = "Talk About", Q6_ignore = "Ignore")

q6_order   = c("Very willing", "Somewhat willing", "Neutral",
               "Somewhat unwilling", "Very unwilling")
q6_palette = c("#4575b4", "#91bfdb", "#ffffbf", "#fc8d59", "#d73027")

AINewsEngagement = create_content(data = data, type = "stackedbar") %>%
  add_viz(filter = ~ !is.na(country),
          x_vars = q6_vars,
          x_var_labels = q6_labels,
          stack_order = q6_order,
          color_palette = q6_palette,
          stacked_type = "percent",
          x_label = "", y_label = "Percent (%)",
          tooltip_suffix = "%", title = "",
          title_tabset = "All Countries", tabgroup = "Willingness to Engage across countries") %>%
  add_viz(x_vars = q6_vars,
          x_var_labels = q6_labels,
          stack_order = q6_order,
          color_palette = q6_palette,
          filter = ~ country =="Netherlands",
          stacked_type = "percent",
          x_label = "", y_label = "Percent (%)",
          tooltip_suffix = "%", title = "",
          title_tabset = "Netherlands", tabgroup = "Willingness to Engage across countries") %>%
  add_viz(x_vars = q6_vars,
          x_var_labels = q6_labels,
          stack_order = q6_order,
          color_palette = q6_palette,
          filter = ~ country =="Denmark",
          stacked_type = "percent",
          x_label = "", y_label = "Percent (%)",
          tooltip_suffix = "%", title = "",
          title_tabset = "Denmark", tabgroup = "Willingness to Engage across countries") %>%
  add_viz(x_vars = q6_vars,
          x_var_labels = q6_labels,
          stack_order = q6_order,
          color_palette = q6_palette,
          filter = ~ country =="USA",
          stacked_type = "percent",
          x_label = "", y_label = "Percent (%)",
          tooltip_suffix = "%", title = "",
          title_tabset = "USA", tabgroup = "Willingness to Engage across countries") %>%
  add_viz(x_vars = q6_vars,
          x_var_labels = q6_labels,
          stack_order = q6_order,
          color_palette = q6_palette,
          filter = ~ country =="Brazil",
          stacked_type = "percent",
```

### Journalistic principles

```{r}
q7_item_order = function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(item) %>%
    summarise(pct = mean(mentioned), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(pct)) %>%
    pull(item)
}

q7_colors = c(
  "Transparency about AI use"        = "#4E79A7",
  "Protecting intellectual property" = "#F28E2B",
  "Human responsibility for content" = "#E15759",
  "Avoiding discrimination"          = "#76B7B2",
  "Preventing job replacement"       = "#59A14F",
  "Maintaining content quality"      = "#EDC948",
  "Protecting user privacy"          = "#B07AA1",
  "Political neutrality"             = "#FF9DA7",
  "Accessibility of content"         = "#9C755F",
  "Diversity of perspectives"        = "#BAB0AC",
  "Environmental sustainability"     = "#499894"
)

q7_long = data %>%
  select(country, age_cat, gender, education, starts_with("Q7_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(country, age_cat, gender, education), names_to = "item", values_to = "mentioned") %>%
  mutate(mentioned = ifelse(mentioned == "Mentioned", 1, 0),
         mentioned = as.numeric(mentioned) * 100,
    item = recode(item,
      "Q7_transparency"         = "Transparency about AI use",
      "Q7_intellectual_property" = "Protecting intellectual property",
      "Q7_human_responsibility"  = "Human responsibility for content",
      "Q7_discrimination"        = "Avoiding discrimination",
      "Q7_job_replacement"       = "Preventing job replacement",
      "Q7_quality"               = "Maintaining content quality",
      "Q7_privacy"               = "Protecting user privacy",
      "Q7_political_neutrality"  = "Political neutrality",
      "Q7_accessibility"         = "Accessibility of content",
      "Q7_diversity"             = "Diversity of perspectives",
      "Q7_environment"           = "Environmental sustainability",
      "Q7_dont_know"             = "Don't know"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(item != "Don't know")

Q7_mentions = create_content(data = q7_long, type = "bar") %>%
  add_viz(filter = ~ !is.na(country),
          x_var = "item", value_var = "mentioned", bar_type = "mean",
          x_order = q7_item_order(q7_long),
          color_palette = q7_colors[q7_item_order(q7_long)],
          horizontal = TRUE,
          x_label = "", y_label = "% mentioned", tooltip_suffix = "%",
          title = "Journalistic Principles", title_tabset = "All Countries",
          tabgroup = "Journalistic Principles across countries") %>%
  add_viz(x_var = "item", value_var = "mentioned", bar_type = "mean",
          x_order = q7_item_order(q7_long %>% filter(country == "Netherlands")),
          color_palette = q7_colors[q7_item_order(q7_long %>% filter(country == "Netherlands"))],
          filter = ~ country == "Netherlands",
          horizontal = TRUE,
          x_label = "", y_label = "% mentioned", tooltip_suffix = "%",
          title = "Journalistic Principles", title_tabset = "Netherlands",
          tabgroup = "Journalistic Principles across countries") %>%
  add_viz(x_var = "item", value_var = "mentioned", bar_type = "mean",

          color_palette = q7_colors[q7_item_order(q7_long %>% filter(country == "Denmark"))],
          filter = ~ country == "Denmark",
          horizontal = TRUE,
          x_label = "", y_label = "% mentioned", tooltip_suffix = "%",
          title = "Journalistic Principles", title_tabset = "Denmark",
          tabgroup = "Journalistic Principles across countries") %>%
  add_viz(x_var = "item", value_var = "mentioned", bar_type = "mean",

  add_viz(x_var = "item", value_var = "mentioned", bar_type = "mean",
```

## Regulatory Preferences

### Regulatory models

```{r}
q10_vars <- c("Q10_developers_are_responsible", "Q10_free_companies",
             "Q10_government_decides", "Q10_involve_civil_society",
             "Q10_only_regulate_high_risk", "Q10_right_to_complain")

q10_labels = c(
  Q10_developers_are_responsible = "The developers of AI should make sure that the technology is safe to use and respects the rights of users.",
  Q10_free_companies             = "AI should not be regulated, so that companies are free to develop AI without interference from government regulations.",
  Q10_government_decides         = "The government should determine when AI is safe to use.",
  Q10_involve_civil_society      = "Developers of AI should involve users or groups, like civil society and consumer organisations in the design of AI.",
  Q10_only_regulate_high_risk    = "Only the riskiest systems with high risks for human rights, health, safety or the planet should be regulated, because too much regulation is bad for innovation.",
  Q10_right_to_complain          = "Users should have a right to complain when their rights and interests are not respected."
)

q10_order   = c("Strongly agree", "Agree", "Neither agree, nor disagree",
                "Disagree", "Strongly disagree")
q10_palette = c("#4575b4", "#91bfdb", "#ffffbf", "#fc8d59", "#d73027")
```

```{r}
q11_colors = c(
  "Economic wellbeing"                   = "#4E79A7",
  "Technological innovation"             = "#F28E2B",
  "Religious beliefs / local traditions" = "#E15759",
  "Human rights"                         = "#76B7B2",
  "Relationships with others"            = "#EDC948",
  "Environment"                          = "#59A14F",
  "State & national security"            = "#B07AA1"
)

item_order = function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(item) %>%
    summarise(pct = mean(mentioned), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(pct)) %>%
    pull(item)
}

q11_long = data %>%
  select(country, age_cat, gender, education, starts_with("Q11_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(country, age_cat, gender, education), names_to = "item", values_to = "mentioned") %>%
  mutate(
    item = recode(item,
      "Q11_economic_wellbeing"                          = "Economic wellbeing",
      "Q11_technological_innovation"                    = "Technological innovation",
      "Q11_religious_beliefs_or_local_traditions"       = "Religious beliefs / local traditions",
      "Q11_human_rights"                                = "Human rights",
      "Q11_relationships_with_others"                   = "Relationships with others",
      "Q11_environment"                                 = "Environment",
      "Q11_interest_of_the_state_and_national_security" = "State & national security"
    ),
    mentioned = mentioned * 100
  )

Q11_mentions = create_content(data = q11_long, type = "bar") %>%
  add_viz(filter = ~ !is.na(country),
          x_var = "item", value_var = "mentioned", bar_type = "mean",
          x_order = item_order(q11_long),
          color_palette = q11_colors[item_order(q11_long)],
          x_label = "", y_label = "% mentioned", tooltip_suffix = "%",
          title = "Regulatory Priorities", title_tabset = "All Countries",
          tabgroup = "Regulatory Priorities across countries") %>%
```

## Dashboard

```{r}
page_genai = create_page("GenAI use", data) %>%
  add_text('To measure how often, if at all, participants use generative AI tools, we asked them: *In a typical week, how often do you use generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications like ChatGPT, Claude or DeepSeek?*') %>%
  add_spacer(height = "2rem") %>%
  add_content(GenAIuse) %>%
  add_content(GenAIuse_breakdown)

page_news_trust = create_page("Trust in News Media", data) %>%
  add_text('To measure three levels of trust in news media, we asked respondents: *"On a scale from 0 to 10, where 0 means ”no trust at all” and 10 means “complete trust”, how much do you trust the news media in your country?"*', 
           'For illustration, we combined scores into low (0-3), medium (4-7) and high (8-10) levels of trust.') %>%
  add_spacer(height = "2rem") %>%
  add_content(NewsTrust) %>%
  add_content(NewsTrust_breakdown)

page_chatgpt_trust = create_page("Trust in ChatGPT", data) %>%
  add_text('To measure three levels of trust in ChatGPT, we asked respondents: *"On a scale from 0 to 10, where 0 means ”no trust at all” and 10 means “complete trust”, how much do you trust ChatGPT?"*', 
           'For illustration, we combined scores into low (0-3), medium (4-7) and high (8-10) levels of trust.') %>%
  add_spacer(height = "2rem") %>%
  add_content(ChatGPTTrust) %>%
  add_content(ChatGPTTrust_breakdown)

page_social_media_trust = create_page("Trust in Social Media", data) %>%
  add_text('To measure three levels of trust in social media, we asked respondents: *"On a scale from 0 to 10, where 0 means ”no trust at all” and 10 means “complete trust”, how much do you trust social media?"*', 
           'For illustration, we combined scores into low (0-3), medium (4-7) and high (8-10) levels of trust.') %>%
  add_spacer(height = "2rem") %>%
  add_content(SocialMediaTrust) %>%
  add_content(SocialMediaTrust_breakdown)

page_authenticity_feelings = create_page("Authenticity Feelings") %>%
  add_text('To measure how people feel about the impact of AI on authenticity, we asked them with the help of a feeling thermometer whether they think that the use of AI to help create journalistic content will affect their ability to do the following positively (= 100) or negatively (= 0).',
  '***Reading example:***',
  '*The graph shows a box plot. The line in the middle marks the median value and the box limits indicate the range of the central 50% of the dataset. The lines on each side capture the range of the remaining data. Example: The ability to check if the content is based on facts or reality has a median of 63, which means that 25% of the participants score below 37 and 25% above 81.*') %>%
  add_spacer(height = "2rem") %>%
  add_content(authenticity_feelings) %>%
  add_content(authenticity_feelings_breakdown)

page_authenticity_rankings = create_page("Authenticity Rankings") %>%
  add_text('To measure what individuals consider authentic journalistic content, we asked them to rank the following statements according from 1 (*most authentic*) to 5 (*least authentic*).',
           '***Reading example***:',
           '*In each of the six countries, people said that journalistic content that expresses a writer’s character, beliefs or personality is considered the most authentic journalistic content.*') %>%
  add_spacer(height = "2rem") %>%
  add_content(authenticity_ranking_viz)

page_journalistic_principles = create_page("Journalistic Principles") %>%
  add_text('To measure which journalistic principles should guide the use of AI in journalism, we asked our respondents to choose their top three out of 11 commonly named principles.', 
           '***Reading example***:',
           '*37.9% of all respondents across countries chose “maintaining content quality” as one of their top three journalistic principles.*') %>%
  add_spacer(height = "2rem") %>%
  add_content(Q7_mentions) %>%
  add_content(Q7_mentions_breakdown)

page_willingness_to_engage = create_page("Willingness to Engage") %>%
  add_text('To measure how willing individuals are to engage with AI generated journalistic content, we asked them to indicate their willingness to read, share, trust, talk about and ignore AI-supported news on a 5-point scale (1 = very unwilling; 5 = very willing)') %>%
  add_spacer(height = "2rem") %>%
  add_content(AINewsEngagement) %>%
  add_content(AINewsEngagement_breakdown)

page_hyperpersonalisation = create_page("Attitudes towards Hyperpersonalisation") %>%
  add_text('***Definition:*** Hyperpersonalization uses generative AI to tailor news to individuals’ preferences and present it in flexible formats and ways. For example, generative AI can turn a news article into an audio clip or a short summary, making it more engaging and relevant for different individuals.', 
  'To measure what people think about hyperpeersonalisation, we asked our respondents to what extent they agree with the statements below:') %>%
  add_spacer(height = "2rem") %>%
  add_content(Hyperpersonalisation) %>%
  add_content(Hyperpersonalisation_breakdown)

page_credibility = create_page("Aspects influencing Credibility Judgements") %>%
  add_text('To measure the importance of specific aspects which influence the credibility of AI-supported journalistic content, we asked the following: *When you read an article that may be written by generative AI, how does each of the following factors influence how much you believe the content?*') %>%
  add_spacer(height = "2rem") %>%
  add_content(Credibility) %>%
  add_content(Credibility_breakdown)

page_regulatory_priorities = create_page("Regulatory Priorities") %>%
  add_text('As AI technologies impact different aspects of society, we measured the priorities individuals have when it comes to which aspects of life AI regulation should protect. We asked them to choose their top three aspects.',
           '***Reading example:***', 
           '*67.7% of all respondents across countries chose “human rights” as one of their top three aspects that AI regulation should protect.*') %>%
  add_spacer(height = "2rem") %>%
  add_content(Q11_mentions) %>%
  add_content(Q11_mentions_breakdown)

page_regulatory_attitudes = create_page("Attitudes towards Regulation") %>%
  add_text('To measure what people think AI regulation should do and who should be held accountable, we asked our respondents to indicate to what extent they agree with the following statements regarding AI regulation.') %>%
  add_spacer(height = "2rem") %>%
  add_content(RegulatoryModels) %>%
  add_content(RegulatoryModels_breakdown)
```

```{r}
background_menu = navbar_menu(

)

)

)


AIJournalismDashboard = create_dashboard(
  title = "AI & Journalism Explorer",
  theme = "flatly",

) %>%
```
